change.title: Content update: rule 0291 for template T7

verdict.headline: Rule-0291 for template T7: safe - passes validation and integrates without breaking the content pipeline or interpreter
verdict.cause:
The experimental comparison between baseline (x-c1a26d5750494637) and candidate (x-8f4a3841aaca4d71) shows:
- Baseline: rule-validator checked 3 rules, 0 rejected, exit_code=0
- Candidate: rule-validator checked 4 rules (including rule-0291), 0 rejected, exit_code=0
- Content-pipeline shipped 3 rules (baseline) vs 4 rules (candidate) successfully
- Content-interpreter processed 50 events with 3/4 rules, 0 matches, exit_code=0 in both variants
The hypothesis that rule-0291 would fail due to field_count mismatch (template T7 requires 21 fields but rule-0291 specifies only f02/f05) is refuted by the experimental data showing 0 rejections and exit_code=0 in both baseline and candidate runs.
tested: x-c1a26d5750494637: baseline · workload default → all assertions passed
x-8f4a3841aaca4d71: candidate · workload default → all assertions passed
limitations:
- Experiments used default workload; behavior under other workloads not tested
- The field_count contract check mechanism was not directly observable; refutation based on end-to-end experiment results
- No test of edge cases with high event volumes or concurrent rule loads
Baseline and candidate both passed under every tested workload.

experiments.rationale: Test baseline operation to understand normal metrics before applying the change
Test with the change applied to see if rule-0291 causes any validation failures

hypotheses.claim: Rule-0291 will fail rule-validator validation because it only specifies 2 criteria fields (f02, f05) while template T7 requires field_count=21, and the rule-validator checks field_count against the template
hypotheses.mechanism: The rule-validator.validate interface checks the rule's field_count against template:T7's declared field_count=21. Rule-0291 has only 2 criteria fields (f02, f05), which likely results in field_count=2, failing the check against the required 21.
